_comment: Model v1 priors. Explicit, configurable, NOT fitted to any historical day. Signed features are oriented so + = bullish evidence; DOWN uses the same weights on the negated z-scores. Keep or drop features based on the walk-forward IC report (python 945.py --backtest ...).
_score_mapping_note: Calibrated to the noise floor: on synthetic random 989-stock sessions the best raw evidence is ~1.8-2.0 (score ~70). 95+ requires raw >= ~2.9, i.e. almost every signed feature aligned near the clip. Score is a ranking score, not a probability.
